newsitem.title: CANADA: Northern Telecom shares rise on earnings.
newsitem.headline: Northern Telecom shares rise on earnings.

text.p: Shares in Northern Telecom Ltd surged on Tuesday after the company beat analysts' consensus estimates with its first quarter earnings.
"Nortel we view as a core investment holding, and these guys really posted a very strong first quarter," said Jim Parmalee, an industry analyst at Deutsche Morgan Grenfell.
Parmalee said he had expected earnings a share for the first quarter to come in at US$0.37. Nortel earned US$0.41 a share, up from US$0.32 a year earlier. Consensus estimates were US$0.38 a share.
Orders rose 35 percent to US$3.57 billion in the first quarter, an increase which garnered praise from the investment community.
Nortel stock jumped to a high of 95.45 on the Toronto Stock Exchange in early afternoon action before pulling back to trade up 3.20 at 95.15.
In New York, the stock was 2-3/8 higher at 68-1/8, off a session peak of 68-3/8.
"It was a good quarter. Revenues beat our estimates. Earnings per share beat our estimates. Booking trends were very good," said Nikos Theodosopoulos, an analyst at UBS Securities.
He was anticipating earnings per share of US$0.37.
"We are maintaining our buy. We have a target of US$75 to US$80 (a share)," Theodosopoulos said.
